extractionFlags.message: Added by hand at Jeff's request, not extracted from a director email: no email or archive exists for this week. Single Monday 2026-10-26 session.

New drill written from the YouTube transcript (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EDJKPs2Qcag), not transcribed verbatim; the video is embedded at 0:56-1:36. Title is a made-up name. The clip starts at the one-two progression, so the basic pass-and-move variation is not described.
Items 2-4 are the last three drills of the Wednesday 2026-10-14 session, in their original order.

Wednesday 2026-10-28 session added by hand at Jeff's request from his typed notes, not a director email. All four drills are new, with no PDF or diagram. Setup and instructions are Jeff's wording split into entries. Jeff gave no coaching points, and validate.py requires non-empty lists, so each drill's single coachingPoints entry is a restatement of his instructions, not new content. Team scrimmage has only a placeholder setup, instruction and coaching point. Equipment and tags are inferred.
